title: ToggleButtonConfig
description: Serializable configuration for the accessible RibbonUI toggle button atom.

label.description: Visible text that also supplies the toggle button's accessible name.

pressed.description: Controlled pressed state rendered as aria-pressed; the host owns the value.

variant.description: Semantic visual emphasis of the toggle button.

size.description: Explicit toggle button density and target size.

disabled.description: Whether native activation and focus participation are disabled.
